items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: Yeah, Dave Jones, melaphone, guitar, bass, piano, and drums. Nine pieces.

ctx.x: Let me see, we had trombone, two trombones, clarinet, and melaphone. Was it Dave Jones? Yeah, Dave Jones, melaphone, guitar, bass, piano, and drums. Nine pieces. And then people would rave and bother saying...
Were you playing string bass? No, two bass.
